_comment: Copy this file to products.json and edit that copy.
products.example.json belongs to Docket and is replaced by updates.
products.json belongs to you and is never touched by an update.
Add one entry per product you support. There is no limit, on any tier.
id        url-safe, lowercase, no spaces. Becomes /<id>/ and prefixes
every item id, so pick it once and do not change it later.
name      shown everywhere a human reads it
tagline   one sentence, used on the product page and in search results
platform  optional pill beside the name: macOS, iOS, Web, API, and so on
url       optional link back to the product's own site
accent    the product's colour, used across its board
icon      optional path under assets/. Falls back to a coloured monogram.
Drop a <name>-dark.png beside it and the feedback widget uses
that on its dark panel, where a dark mark would disappear
sections  which boards this product has, in sidebar order

products.name: Aurora
products.tagline: One shared inbox for your whole team.

products.name: Pico
products.tagline: A very small timer that lives in your menu bar.
